resource_limits.execution: All seven suites ran together in a bounded Ollie user unit using installed NumPy; tests do not perform network access, GPU execution, or VM operations.

scope: Source/mock tests, not playback qualification or measured optimization savings. Exact same-candidate matched-frame gates, isolated configuration flags, actual successful-use counters, optional movie capture subtitle-state restoration before Stop, owned-service error cleanup with capture disabled, packed planar routes, duration-weighted CPU/GPU and strict whole-service sampled memory aggregation, and private-data sanitization were tested. Existing default and zoom capture behavior remains covered.
